set -euo pipefail OUT="$PWD/verification-output" python - <<"PY" import os, socket from pathlib import Path assert not any(os.environ.get(key) for key in ("GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN", "SSH_AUTH_SOCK", "ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN")) assert not Path("/var/run/docker.sock").exists() assert not Path("/candidate/.git").exists() try: Path("/candidate/write-probe").write_text("unexpected") except OSError: pass else: raise SystemExit("candidate mount is writable") with socket.socket() as probe: probe.settimeout(1) try: probe.connect(("1.1.1.1", 443)) except OSError: pass else: raise SystemExit("network is accessible") print("Isolation probes passed: offline, read-only source, no credential environment or engine socket") PY python -m compileall -q apps tools tests python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --junitxml="$OUT/pytest.xml" python tests/test_blender_runtime_52.py for file in CutBridge.jsx revision_manager.js qc_plus.js localization.js; do node_file="$file" if [[ "$file" == CutBridge.jsx ]]; then node_file=CutBridge.js; fi cp "apps/after-effects/$file" "$TMPDIR/$node_file" node --check "$TMPDIR/$node_file" done for check in ae_s6_revision_checks ae_s6_optional_pass_lifecycle_checks ae_s6_extend_script_binding_checks ae_s7_qc_plus_checks ae_s7_native_qc_binding_checks ae_s8_localization_checks ae_s8_native_ui_binding_checks ae_s10c_reconstruction_checks ae_s13_revision_3d_tag_migration_checks; do node "tests/$check.cjs" done VERSION="$(python -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.load(open(\"apps/blender/cutbridge/blender_manifest.toml\", \"rb\"))[\"version\"], end=\"\")")" python tools/build_release.py --tag "v${VERSION}" --output "$OUT/dist-ci" python tools/build_release.py --tag "v${VERSION}" --output "$OUT/dist-repeat" (cd "$OUT/dist-ci" && sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS.txt) for artifact in "$OUT/dist-ci/"*; do cmp "$artifact" "$OUT/dist-repeat/$(basename "$artifact")" done python - <<"DISTRIBUTION_PY" import importlib.util, json, shutil, tomllib, zipfile from pathlib import Path import jsonschema out = Path("verification-output") metadata = json.loads((out / "dist-ci/release-metadata.json").read_text()) index = json.loads(Path("production-release-index.json").read_text()) before = list(index["releases"]) version = metadata["version"] base = "https://unn0wn002.github.io/cutbridge-distribution" archive = metadata["artifacts"]["blender"] filename = archive["filename"] entry = {"version": version, "channel": "stable", "blender_version_min": metadata["blender_version_min"], "release_page_url": f"{base}/releases/v{version}/", "download_url": f"{base}/releases/v{version}/{filename}", "sha256": archive["sha256"]} assert not any(item["version"] == version for item in before), "candidate is already advertised" index["releases"] = [entry, *before] index.pop("generated_at", None) jsonschema.validate(index, json.loads(Path("packages/update/release-index.schema.json").read_text())) spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("updates", "apps/blender/cutbridge/updates.py") updates = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec) spec.loader.exec_module(updates) for current in ("0.2.3", version, "99.0.0"): selected = updates.select_latest_compatible(index, current_version=current, blender_version=(5, 2, 1), platform_name="windows-x64") assert (selected["version"] if selected else None) == (version if current == "0.2.3" else None) assert index["releases"][1:] == before preview = out / "distribution-preview" (preview / "cutbridge").mkdir(parents=True) (preview / "blender").mkdir() release = preview / "releases" / f"v{version}" release.mkdir(parents=True) for artifact in (out / "dist-ci").iterdir(): shutil.copyfile(artifact, release / artifact.name) (preview / "cutbridge/release-index.json").write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2) + "\n") with zipfile.ZipFile(out / "dist-ci" / archive["filename"]) as package: manifest = tomllib.loads(package.read("blender_manifest.toml").decode()) manifest.pop("build", None) manifest.update(archive_url="./" + archive["filename"], archive_size=(out / "dist-ci" / archive["filename"]).stat().st_size, archive_hash="sha256:" + archive["sha256"]) (preview / "blender/index.json").write_text(json.dumps({"version": "v1", "blocklist": [], "data": [manifest]}, indent=2) + "\n") shutil.copyfile(out / "dist-ci" / archive["filename"], preview / "blender" / archive["filename"]) links = "".join(f"
  • {artifact.name}
    • " for artifact in sorted(release.iterdir())) (release / "index.html").write_text(f"CutBridge v{version} candidate

    CutBridge v{version} candidate

    Unpublished preview. Release authorization and published-download verification are required before distribution.

      {links}
    ") (preview / "DO_NOT_PUBLISH.txt").write_text("Unpublished candidate artifacts. Verify the authorized published release before mirroring. Preserve the production v0.2.3 tree; do not replace it with this partial preview.\n") print("Distribution preview: schema, preserved prior entries, v0.2.3 update selection and no downgrade passed; NOT PUBLISHED") DISTRIBUTION_PY echo "Canonical checks and deterministic repeated packaging passed"
